baseline.sourceOfTruth: Codex app-server Thread, Turn, ThreadItem, server request, and notification protocol

identity.pendingRequest: request.id scoped by params.threadId and params.turnId
identity.rule: item/started inserts, deltas mutate the matching live item, item/completed replaces it authoritatively, and thread/read replay reconciles by stable item id

components.userMessage: user bubble with text, image, audio, skill, and mention attachments
components.agentMessage: sanitized Markdown response with streaming cursor only while live
components.reasoning: collapsed reasoning disclosure with streamed summary
components.plan: structured plan card with streaming or final progress
components.commandExecution: collapsible terminal group with cwd, command, output, duration, and exit status
components.fileChange: file list and sanitized unified diff disclosure
components.mcpToolCall: tool card with server, arguments, progress, result, error, and duration
components.dynamicToolCall: tool card with namespace, arguments, output, and success
components.collabAgentToolCall: delegated-agent group with receiver threads and agent states
components.imageView: local image activity without embedding an unsafe path
components.unknown: inspectable unsupported-item fallback that preserves type and never invents success

streaming.paintCadence: coalesce notifications into at most one animation-frame render
streaming.replay: thread/read is authoritative durable history and never implies live presence
streaming.reconnect: resume from host event cursor, then reconcile with thread/read before showing settled state
streaming.backpressure: host retains a bounded 500-event window; UI retains only active live items and renders a bounded 240-item tail before virtualization
streaming.unknownDelta: ignore visually, preserve raw host event for diagnostics, and reconcile on the next thread/read

turnLifecycle.idle: composer enabled and no live claim
turnLifecycle.starting: optimistic user input may render but send is guarded until turn/start returns
turnLifecycle.running: trusted turn/started or active thread status; Stop replaces Send
turnLifecycle.waitingHuman: scoped server request renders inline and remains separate from VibeHub Task attention
turnLifecycle.retrying: error notification with willRetry true; keep the Turn open and expose retry state
turnLifecycle.failed: terminal error or failed item; keep output inspectable and offer a new Turn, never rewrite history
turnLifecycle.interrupted: turn/interrupt followed by authoritative completion status; no false completed claim
turnLifecycle.completed: turn/completed reconciled with thread/read; completion is not a VibeHub Outcome

keyboard.interrupt: Escape when the composer owns the active running Turn

composer.audioBoundary: ordinary audio input is supported; realtime conversation remains hidden until the runtime probe reports support

security.markdown: escape first; allow only independently rendered links, code, emphasis, lists, and headings; no raw HTML
security.diffsAndOutput: textContent-equivalent escaping inside bounded pre elements
security.media: bounded data URLs or explicitly served local assets only
security.approvals: render only exact server requests and send exact supported decisions
security.repositoryWrites: the shell host remains read-only; only Codex app-server execution may write under its approval and sandbox contract

performance.rule: production must virtualize above the threshold; the research prototype bounds the DOM tail and disclosures

vibehubBoundary.rule: VibeHub actions may reference exact Thread, Turn, item, and selection identity but never relabel Codex protocol objects
